===== M1515 =====
Signature: com.google.javascript.jscomp.PeepholeSubstituteAlternateSyntax.tryRemoveRedundantExit(Node)
Source: src/com/google/javascript/jscomp/PeepholeSubstituteAlternateSyntax.java
Original range: 514-545
Documentation:
/**
   * Remove duplicate exits.  If the node following the exit node expression
   * has the same effect as exit node, the node can be removed.
   * For example:
   *   "if (a) {return f()} return f();" ==> "if (a) {} return f();"
   *   "if (a) {throw 'ow'} throw 'ow';" ==> "if (a) {} throw 'ow';"
   *
   * @param n An follow control exit expression (a THROW or RETURN node)
   * @return The replacement for n, or the original if no change was made.
   */
Method code:
514 |   private Node tryRemoveRedundantExit(Node n) {
515 |     Node exitExpr = n.getFirstChild();
516 | 
517 |     Node follow = ControlFlowAnalysis.computeFollowNode(n);
518 | 
519 |     // Skip pass all the finally blocks because both the fall through and return
520 |     // will also trigger all the finally blocks.
521 |     Node prefinallyFollows = follow;
522 |     follow = skipFinallyNodes(follow);
523 |     if (prefinallyFollows != follow) {
524 |       // There were finally clauses
525 |       if (!isPure(exitExpr)) {
526 |         // Can't replace the return
527 |         return n;
528 |       }
529 |     }
530 | 
531 |     if (follow == null && (n.isThrow() || exitExpr != null)) {
532 |       // Can't complete remove a throw here or a return with a result.
533 |       return n;
534 |     }
535 | 
536 |     // When follow is null, this mean the follow of a break target is the
537 |     // end of a function. This means a break is same as return.
538 |     if (follow == null || areMatchingExits(n, follow)) {
539 |       n.detachFromParent();
540 |       reportCodeChange();
541 |       return null;
542 |     }
543 | 
544 |     return n;
545 |   }

361 |                 }

233 |   private Node tryFoldImmediateCallToBoundFunction(Node n) {
234 |     // Rewriting "(fn.bind(a,b))()" to "fn.call(a,b)" makes it inlinable
235 |     Preconditions.checkState(n.isCall());
236 |     Node callTarget = n.getFirstChild();
237 |     Bind bind = getCodingConvention().describeFunctionBind(callTarget, false);
238 |     if (bind != null) {
239 |       // replace the call target
240 |       bind.target.detachFromParent();

242 |       callTarget = bind.target;
243 | 
244 |       // push the parameters
245 |       addParameterAfter(bind.parameters, callTarget);
246 | 
247 |       // add the this value before the parameters if necessary
248 |       if (bind.thisValue != null && !NodeUtil.isUndefined(bind.thisValue)) {
249 |         // rewrite from "fn(a, b)" to "fn.call(thisValue, a, b)"
250 |         Node newCallTarget = IR.getprop(

252 |             IR.string("call").srcref(callTarget));

254 |         n.addChildAfter(bind.thisValue.cloneTree(), newCallTarget);

256 |       } else {

259 |       reportCodeChange();

Signature: com.google.javascript.jscomp.PeepholeRemoveDeadCode.tryFoldIf(Node)
Source: src/com/google/javascript/jscomp/PeepholeRemoveDeadCode.java
Original range: 622-721
Documentation:
/**
   * Try folding IF nodes by removing dead branches.
   * @return the replacement node, if changed, or the original if not
   */
Method code:
622 |   private Node tryFoldIf(Node n) {
623 |     Preconditions.checkState(n.isIf());
624 |     Node parent = n.getParent();
625 |     Preconditions.checkNotNull(parent);
626 |     int type = n.getType();
627 |     Node cond = n.getFirstChild();
628 |     Node thenBody = cond.getNext();
629 |     Node elseBody = thenBody.getNext();
630 | 
631 |     // if (x) { .. } else { } --> if (x) { ... }
632 |     if (elseBody != null && !mayHaveSideEffects(elseBody)) {
633 |       n.removeChild(elseBody);
634 |       elseBody = null;
635 |       reportCodeChange();
636 |     }
637 | 
638 |     // if (x) { } else { ... } --> if (!x) { ... }
639 |     if (!mayHaveSideEffects(thenBody) && elseBody != null) {
640 |       n.removeChild(elseBody);
641 |       n.replaceChild(thenBody, elseBody);
642 |       Node notCond = new Node(Token.NOT);
643 |       n.replaceChild(cond, notCond);
644 |       notCond.addChildToFront(cond);
645 |       cond = notCond;
646 |       thenBody = cond.getNext();
647 |       elseBody = null;
648 |       reportCodeChange();
649 |     }
650 | 
651 |     // if (x()) { }
652 |     if (!mayHaveSideEffects(thenBody) && elseBody == null) {
653 |       if (mayHaveSideEffects(cond)) {
654 |         // x() has side effects, just leave the condition on its own.
655 |         n.removeChild(cond);
656 |         Node replacement = NodeUtil.newExpr(cond);
657 |         parent.replaceChild(n, replacement);
658 |         reportCodeChange();
659 |         return replacement;
660 |       } else {
661 |         // x() has no side effects, the whole tree is useless now.
662 |         NodeUtil.removeChild(parent, n);
663 |         reportCodeChange();
664 |         return null;
665 |       }
666 |     }
667 | 
668 |     // Try transforms that apply to both IF and HOOK.
669 |     TernaryValue condValue = NodeUtil.getImpureBooleanValue(cond);
670 |     if (condValue == TernaryValue.UNKNOWN) {
671 |       return n;  // We can't remove branches otherwise!
672 |     }
673 | 
674 |     if (mayHaveSideEffects(cond)) {
675 |       // Transform "if (a = 2) {x =2}" into "if (true) {a=2;x=2}"
676 |       boolean newConditionValue = condValue == TernaryValue.TRUE;
677 |       // Add an elseBody if it is needed.
678 |       if (!newConditionValue && elseBody == null) {
679 |         elseBody = IR.block().srcref(n);
680 |         n.addChildToBack(elseBody);
681 |       }
682 |       Node newCond = NodeUtil.booleanNode(newConditionValue);
683 |       n.replaceChild(cond, newCond);
684 |       Node branchToKeep = newConditionValue ? thenBody : elseBody;
685 |       branchToKeep.addChildToFront(IR.exprResult(cond).srcref(cond));
686 |       reportCodeChange();
687 |       cond = newCond;
688 |     }
689 | 
690 |     boolean condTrue = condValue.toBoolean(true);
691 |     if (n.getChildCount() == 2) {
692 |       Preconditions.checkState(type == Token.IF);
693 | 
694 |       if (condTrue) {
695 |         // Replace "if (true) { X }" with "X".
696 |         Node thenStmt = n.getFirstChild().getNext();
697 |         n.removeChild(thenStmt);
698 |         parent.replaceChild(n, thenStmt);
699 |         reportCodeChange();
700 |         return thenStmt;
701 |       } else {
702 |         // Remove "if (false) { X }" completely.
703 |         NodeUtil.redeclareVarsInsideBranch(n);
704 |         NodeUtil.removeChild(parent, n);
705 |         reportCodeChange();
706 |         return null;
707 |       }
708 |     } else {
709 |       // Replace "if (true) { X } else { Y }" with X, or
710 |       // replace "if (false) { X } else { Y }" with Y.
711 |       Node trueBranch = n.getFirstChild().getNext();
712 |       Node falseBranch = trueBranch.getNext();
713 |       Node branchToKeep = condTrue ? trueBranch : falseBranch;
714 |       Node branchToRemove = condTrue ? falseBranch : trueBranch;
715 |       NodeUtil.redeclareVarsInsideBranch(branchToRemove);
716 |       n.removeChild(branchToKeep);
717 |       parent.replaceChild(n, branchToKeep);
718 |       reportCodeChange();
719 |       return branchToKeep;
720 |     }
721 |   }

99 |   private Node tryFoldBinaryOperator(Node subtree) {
100 |     Node left = subtree.getFirstChild();
101 | 
102 |     if (left == null) {
103 |       return subtree;
104 |     }
105 | 
106 |     Node right = left.getNext();
107 | 
108 |     if (right == null) {
109 |       return subtree;
110 |     }
111 | 
112 |     // If we've reached here, node is truly a binary operator.
113 |     switch(subtree.getType()) {
114 |       case Token.GETPROP:
115 |         return tryFoldGetProp(subtree, left, right);
116 | 
117 |       case Token.GETELEM:
118 |         return tryFoldGetElem(subtree, left, right);
119 | 
120 |       case Token.INSTANCEOF:
121 |         return tryFoldInstanceof(subtree, left, right);
122 | 
123 |       case Token.AND:
124 |       case Token.OR:
125 |         return tryFoldAndOr(subtree, left, right);
126 | 
127 |       case Token.LSH:
128 |       case Token.RSH:
129 |       case Token.URSH:
130 |         return tryFoldShift(subtree, left, right);
131 | 
132 |       case Token.ASSIGN:
133 |         return tryFoldAssign(subtree, left, right);
134 | 
135 |       case Token.ASSIGN_BITOR:
136 |       case Token.ASSIGN_BITXOR:
137 |       case Token.ASSIGN_BITAND:
138 |       case Token.ASSIGN_LSH:
139 |       case Token.ASSIGN_RSH:
140 |       case Token.ASSIGN_URSH:
141 |       case Token.ASSIGN_ADD:
142 |       case Token.ASSIGN_SUB:
143 |       case Token.ASSIGN_MUL:
144 |       case Token.ASSIGN_DIV:
145 |       case Token.ASSIGN_MOD:
146 |         return tryUnfoldAssignOp(subtree, left, right);
147 | 
148 |       case Token.ADD:
149 |         return tryFoldAdd(subtree, left, right);
150 | 
151 |       case Token.SUB:
152 |       case Token.DIV:
153 |       case Token.MOD:
154 |         return tryFoldArithmeticOp(subtree, left, right);
155 | 
156 |       case Token.MUL:
157 |       case Token.BITAND:
158 |       case Token.BITOR:
159 |       case Token.BITXOR:
160 |         Node result = tryFoldArithmeticOp(subtree, left, right);
161 |         if (result != subtree) {
162 |           return result;
163 |         }
164 |         return tryFoldLeftChildOp(subtree, left, right);
165 | 
166 |       case Token.LT:
167 |       case Token.GT:
168 |       case Token.LE:
169 |       case Token.GE:
170 |       case Token.EQ:
171 |       case Token.NE:
172 |       case Token.SHEQ:
173 |       case Token.SHNE:
174 |         return tryFoldComparison(subtree, left, right);
175 | 
176 |       default:

178 |     }

Signature: com.google.javascript.jscomp.RenameVars.getLocalVarIndex(Var)
Source: src/com/google/javascript/jscomp/RenameVars.java
Original range: 545-567
Documentation:
/**
   * Returns the index within the scope stack.
   * e.g. function Foo(a) { var b; function c(d) { } }
   * a = 0, b = 1, c = 2, d = 3
   */
Method code:
545 |   private int getLocalVarIndex(Var v) {
546 |     int num = v.index;
547 |     Scope s = v.scope.getParent();
548 |     if (s == null) {
549 |       throw new IllegalArgumentException("Var is not local");
550 |     }
551 | 
552 |     boolean isBleedingIntoScope = s.getParent() != null &&
553 |         localBleedingFunctions.contains(v);
554 | 
555 |     while (s.getParent() != null) {
556 |       if (isBleedingIntoScope) {
557 |         num += localBleedingFunctionsPerScope.get(s).indexOf(v) + 1;
558 |         isBleedingIntoScope = false;
559 |       } else {
560 |         num += localBleedingFunctionsPerScope.get(s).size();
561 |       }
562 | 
563 |       num += s.getVarCount();
564 |       s = s.getParent();
565 |     }
566 |     return num;
567 |   }

===== M1574 =====
Signature: com.google.javascript.jscomp.RemoveUnusedVars.traverseNode(Node,Node,Scope)
Source: src/com/google/javascript/jscomp/RemoveUnusedVars.java
Original range: 192-296
Documentation:
/**
   * Traverses everything in the current scope and marks variables that
   * are referenced.
   *
   * During traversal, we identify subtrees that will only be
   * referenced if their enclosing variables are referenced. Instead of
   * traversing those subtrees, we create a continuation for them,
   * and traverse them lazily.
   */
Method code:
192 |   private void traverseNode(Node n, Node parent, Scope scope) {
193 |     int type = n.getType();
194 |     Var var = null;
195 |     switch (type) {
196 |       case Token.FUNCTION:
197 |         // If this function is a removable var, then create a continuation
198 |         // for it instead of traversing immediately.
199 |         if (NodeUtil.isFunctionDeclaration(n)) {
200 |           var = scope.getVar(n.getFirstChild().getString());
201 |         }
202 | 
203 |         if (var != null && isRemovableVar(var)) {
204 |           continuations.put(var, new Continuation(n, scope));
205 |         } else {
206 |           traverseFunction(n, scope);
207 |         }
208 |         return;
209 | 
210 |       case Token.ASSIGN:
211 |         Assign maybeAssign = Assign.maybeCreateAssign(n);
212 |         if (maybeAssign != null) {
213 |           // Put this in the assign map. It might count as a reference,
214 |           // but we won't know that until we have an index of all assigns.
215 |           var = scope.getVar(maybeAssign.nameNode.getString());
216 |           if (var != null) {
217 |             assignsByVar.put(var, maybeAssign);
218 |             assignsByNode.put(maybeAssign.nameNode, maybeAssign);
219 | 
220 |             if (isRemovableVar(var) &&
221 |                 !maybeAssign.mayHaveSecondarySideEffects) {
222 |               // If the var is unreferenced and performing this assign has
223 |               // no secondary side effects, then we can create a continuation
224 |               // for it instead of traversing immediately.
225 |               continuations.put(var, new Continuation(n, scope));
226 |               return;
227 |             }
228 |           }
229 |         }
230 |         break;
231 | 
232 |       case Token.CALL:
233 |         // Look for calls to inheritance-defining calls (such as goog.inherits).
234 |         SubclassRelationship subclassRelationship =
235 |             codingConvention.getClassesDefinedByCall(n);
236 |         if (subclassRelationship != null) {
237 |           Var subclassVar = scope.getVar(subclassRelationship.subclassName);
238 |           // Don't try to track the inheritance calls for non-globals. It would
239 |           // be more correct to only not track when the subclass does not
240 |           // reference a constructor, but checking that it is a global is
241 |           // easier and mostly the same.
242 |           if (subclassVar != null && subclassVar.isGlobal()
243 |               && !referenced.contains(subclassVar)) {
244 |             // Save a reference to the EXPR node.
245 |             inheritsCalls.put(subclassVar, parent);
246 |             continuations.put(subclassVar, new Continuation(n, scope));
247 |             return;
248 |           }
249 |         }
250 |         break;
251 | 
252 |       case Token.NAME:
253 |         var = scope.getVar(n.getString());
254 |         if (parent.isVar()) {
255 |           Node value = n.getFirstChild();
256 |           if (value != null && var != null && isRemovableVar(var) &&
257 |               !NodeUtil.mayHaveSideEffects(value)) {
258 |             // If the var is unreferenced and creating its value has no side
259 |             // effects, then we can create a continuation for it instead
260 |             // of traversing immediately.
261 |             continuations.put(var, new Continuation(n, scope));
262 |             return;
263 |           }
264 |         } else {
265 | 
266 |           // If arguments is escaped, we just assume the worst and continue
267 |           // on all the parameters.
268 |           if ("arguments".equals(n.getString()) && scope.isLocal()) {
269 |             Node lp = scope.getRootNode().getFirstChild().getNext();
270 |             for (Node a = lp.getFirstChild(); a != null; a = a.getNext()) {
271 |               markReferencedVar(scope.getVar(a.getString()));
272 |             }
273 |           }
274 | 
275 |           // All name references that aren't declarations or assigns
276 |           // are references to other vars.
277 |           if (var != null) {
278 |             // If that var hasn't already been marked referenced, then
279 |             // start tracking it.  If this is an assign, do nothing
280 |             // for now.
281 |             if (isRemovableVar(var)) {
282 |               if (!assignsByNode.containsKey(n)) {
283 |                 markReferencedVar(var);
284 |               }
285 |             } else {
286 |               markReferencedVar(var);
287 |             }
288 |           }
289 |         }
290 |         break;
291 |     }
292 | 
293 |     for (Node c = n.getFirstChild(); c != null; c = c.getNext()) {
294 |       traverseNode(c, n, scope);
295 |     }
296 |   }

106 |   @Override
107 |   public void hotSwapScript(Node root, Node originalRoot) {
108 |     Traversal traversal = new Traversal();
109 |     NodeTraversal.traverse(compiler, root, traversal);
110 | 
111 |     if (!traversal.hasErrors()) {
112 | 
113 |       // Apply the aliases.
114 |       for (AliasUsage aliasUsage : traversal.getAliasUsages()) {
115 |         aliasUsage.applyAlias();
116 |       }
117 | 
118 |       // Remove the alias definitions.
119 |       for (Node aliasDefinition : traversal.getAliasDefinitionsInOrder()) {
120 |         if (aliasDefinition.getParent().isVar() &&
121 |             aliasDefinition.getParent().hasOneChild()) {
122 |           aliasDefinition.getParent().detachFromParent();
123 |         } else {
124 |           aliasDefinition.detachFromParent();
125 |         }
126 |       }
127 | 
128 |       // Collapse the scopes.

131 |         Node scopeClosureBlock = scopeCall.getLastChild().getLastChild();
132 |         scopeClosureBlock.detachFromParent();

134 |             expressionWithScopeCall,
135 |             scopeClosureBlock);
136 |         NodeUtil.tryMergeBlock(scopeClosureBlock);
137 |       }
138 |

140 |           traversal.getAliasDefinitionsInOrder().size() > 0 ||
141 |           traversal.getScopeCalls().size() > 0) {
142 |         compiler.reportCodeChange();
143 |       }
144 |     }
145 |   }

===== M1586 =====
Signature: com.google.javascript.rhino.jstype.JSType.isSubtype(JSType)
Source: src/com/google/javascript/rhino/jstype/JSType.java
Original range: 1051-1053
Documentation:
/**
   * Checks whether {@code this} is a subtype of {@code that}.<p>
   *
   * Subtyping rules:
   * <ul>
   * <li>(unknown) &mdash; every type is a subtype of the Unknown type.</li>
   * <li>(no) &mdash; the No type is a subtype of every type.</li>
   * <li>(no-object) &mdash; the NoObject type is a subtype of every object
   * type (i.e. subtypes of the Object type).</li>
   * <li>(ref) &mdash; a type is a subtype of itself.</li>
   * <li>(union-l) &mdash; A union type is a subtype of a type U if all the
   * union type's constituents are a subtype of U. Formally<br>
   * {@code (T<sub>1</sub>, &hellip;, T<sub>n</sub>) &lt;: U} if and only
   * {@code T<sub>k</sub> &lt;: U} for all {@code k &isin; 1..n}.</li>
   * <li>(union-r) &mdash; A type U is a subtype of a union type if it is a
   * subtype of one of the union type's constituents. Formally<br>
   * {@code U &lt;: (T<sub>1</sub>, &hellip;, T<sub>n</sub>)} if and only
   * if {@code U &lt;: T<sub>k</sub>} for some index {@code k}.</li>
   * <li>(objects) &mdash; an Object {@code O<sub>1</sub>} is a subtype
   * of an object {@code O<sub>2</sub>} if it has more properties
   * than {@code O<sub>2</sub>} and all common properties are
   * pairwise subtypes.</li>
   * </ul>
   *
   * @return {@code this &lt;: that}
   */
Method code:
1051 |   public boolean isSubtype(JSType that) {
1052 |     return isSubtypeHelper(this, that);
1053 |   }

/**
     * Determines if the variable for this reference collection is
     * "well-defined." A variable is well-defined if we can prove at
     * compile-time that it's assigned a value before it's used.
     *
     * Notice that if this function returns false, this doesn't imply that the
     * variable is used before it's assigned. It just means that we don't
     * have enough information to make a definitive judgment.
     */
Method code:
310 |     protected boolean isWellDefined() {
311 |       int size = references.size();
312 |       if (size == 0) {
313 |         return false;
314 |       }
315 | 
316 |       // If this is a declaration that does not instantiate the variable,
317 |       // it's not well-defined.
318 |       Reference init = getInitializingReference();
319 |       if (init == null) {
320 |         return false;
321 |       }
322 | 
323 |       Preconditions.checkState(references.get(0).isDeclaration());
324 |       BasicBlock initBlock = init.getBasicBlock();
325 |       for (int i = 1; i < size; i++) {
326 |         if (!initBlock.provablyExecutesBefore(
327 |                 references.get(i).getBasicBlock())) {
328 |           return false;
329 |         }
330 |       }
331 | 
332 |       return true;
333 |     }
